authority.action: Created a citation-ready home electrical panel directory and emergency shutoff file with a safety boundary, panel identity record, branch-circuit verification ledger, ambiguity log, emergency handoff, warning-sign escalation rules and maintenance history tied to current CPSC, Ready.gov and ESFI guidance.
authority.cluster: Home safety, outage readiness and emergency documentation, with reciprocal paths from the established power-outage, extension-cord, smoke-alarm and generator guides; the pocket-square and sandbag pages expand separate tailored-accessory and strength-equipment clusters.
authority.opportunity: Three qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for CPSC consumer safety education, the Electrical Safety Foundation International and Ready.gov/FEMA preparedness education; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Fitness: how to identify and document home circuits without entering energized equipment, how to buy and fold a pocket square that fits the actual jacket and dress code, and how to select and commission a fillable training bag without guessing at capacity or progression. The pocket-square page serves purchase intent, the electrical file is the authority asset, and the sandbag guide explores a distinct equipment system. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
